fallback.title: Olymposuite Documentation
fallback.intro: Olymposuite is a suite of self-hosted media automation apps: Zephyrus (torrent download-phase policy), Eros (adult scene collection manager), Psyche (metadata-first TV and movie library automation), and Morpheus (media-archive compression). Pick an app below to get started.
